issue.title: Migrate zorg-era reading records outside ref/ into the reference library

task_type_fields.proposal:
Migrate the zorg-era reading records that live outside `ref/` into the reference library, as a separate Bryan-reviewed epic (the research's Phase 5). Proposed by phase bob-cli-4w.11 (note #2) of epic bob-cli-4w, recorded by bob-cli-4w.land.

`bob ref doctor` now counts these records live: on athena (release build e3e69df, 2026-10-06) the coverage row reported about 424 unindexed `status::` records, led by work_ref.md (75) and nvim_ref.md (69). The research counted about 425. Until they move, `bob ref find` / `list` cannot see that reading history, and every JSON envelope's `coverage.scope` has to say so. The counting rules (`src/native/ref_library/coverage.rs`) give the migration a ready-made inventory: lines matching `^\s*[*-] status::\s*(UNREAD|COLLECT_FLEETING_NOTES|REVIEW_FLEETING_NOTES|REVIEW_LIT_NOTES|READ|ABANDONED|BOOK)\b` outside the ref dir, owned by the nearest less-indented `^z-…` list line, minus records already mirrored into `ref/` (same `source_block` + `source_path`). The design needs Bryan's review: where each record lands (`ref/ai/` like the existing 282 legacy migrations, or per-topic), how the legacy_status mapping and dedupe against existing ref notes work, and what happens to the source hub lines.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-4w's plan lists "Migrating zorg records" under Out of scope, and its research adopts "Migrating the zorg-era records is a separate epic". It is a bulk vault write over hundreds of records, which needs Bryan's review rather than landing inside a read-only library epic.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-4w.11 proposed it as a follow-up; bob ref doctor now counts ~424 unindexed zorg reading records that bob ref find/list cannot see, and epic bob-cli-4w scoped the migration out as a separate Bryan-reviewed epic.

payload.entry: Closed by epic bob-cli-5k.7.1 after the live migration. Vault commit 36bf2172f018095d8cb2330810cf6588ed02ed95 ("bob ref migrate-zorg: 424 records into 322 notes under ref/zorg") is ~/bob HEAD: 322 files, all under ref/zorg/**, worktree clean. Installed bob reports `coverage: ok (no unindexed zorg-era reading records outside ref/)`, library 935 notes, diagnostics still only the two pre-existing ref/ai opaque_url rows. `bob ref migrate-zorg` reports 0 to migrate (already migrated 706 = 282 precedent + 424). Rollback: check `bob vault-sync status --json` shows no sync running, then `git -C ~/bob revert --no-edit 36bf2172f018095d8cb2330810cf6588ed02ed95`, then `bob vault-sync`.
